summary: T-21 rewind.py validated end-to-end in a t27_sandbox Postgres schema + scratch FS root. 7/7 scenarios PASS. Three defects surfaced; one is HIGH-severity (ADR 2026-11-20 mitigation (b) unimplemented: live rewind emits no cross-month SQL detection warning), two are MEDIUM (ergonomic --yes/--dry-run ordering, and the already-known prod fact_trajectory_enriched.ym missing column). Production state untouched across every test. Pytest 92 passed before + after.

defects.summary: Live rewind of a ym range that contains cross-month flights emits no warning. ADR 2026-11-20 mitigation (b) requires both help-text AND a SQL detection snippet; only the help-text (epilog) is present.
defects.patch_1_line: Add a pre-rewind probe: SELECT count(*) FROM sat_flight_summary WHERE ym=next_month(to_ym) AND hk_flight IN (SELECT hk_flight FROM sat_flight_summary WHERE ym BETWEEN from_ym AND to_ym); if >0 print WARNING.
defects.blocks: re-opens rewind E2E (Sc4) for a targeted re-run

defects.summary: python -m etl4.orchestration.rewind --layer all --dry-run (no --yes) exits 1 because rewind_all raises SystemExit before checking dry_run. The dispatch's literal Sc1 command cannot preview the plan.
defects.patch_1_line: In rewind_all, short-circuit the yes-gate when dry_run=True (swap the two if branches).

defects.summary: Live production public.fact_trajectory_enriched lacks the ym column; rewind_sink only works in dry-run against prod. Already tracked by T-12 commit (NEEDS_CHANGES - 3 schema gaps flagged for T-13).
defects.patch_1_line: No action from T-27 side; closes with T-13 ALTER.

sandbox_isolation_proof: POSTGRES_DSN set BEFORE etl4.orchestration.rewind import so DSN_DEFAULT binds to search_path=t27_sandbox
rewind.rewind_vault.__kwdefaults__['root'] and rewind_marts.__kwdefaults__['root'] patched to scratch dirs
All rewind_vault / rewind_marts calls in the driver pass root=<scratch> explicitly
CREATE SCHEMA t27_sandbox + hand-written DDL (no LIKE public.* to avoid sequence/FK coupling)
DROP SCHEMA t27_sandbox CASCADE in finally; confirmed absent post-run

call_order_deviation_informational.resolution: Code order is correct under downstream-first because eval_mart.fact_experiment_result = MAX(ym) over pipeline_runs. Dispatch spec is loose. Not a defect.

next_action: orchestrator: triage D-27-1 (open ticket to developer-backend for cross-month SQL detection snippet), triage D-27-2 (optional ergonomic patch), confirm D-27-3 is covered by T-13. After D-27-1 patch lands, re-run T-27 Sc4 for closure.
